instruction.en:
Press the Learn button Short

On successful inclusion, the blue LED will turn solid for 2 seconds.
On failture inclusion, the red LED will turn solid for 2 seconds.
instruction.de:
Drücken Sie die Taste Learn kurz

Bei erfolgreichem Hinzufügen leuchtet die blaue LED 2 Sekunden lang.
Bei einem Fehler leuchtet die rote LED 2 Sekunden lang.
Drücken Sie die Taste Learn kurz

hint.en:
Group 1 is assigned to the Lifeline association group and every device has 5 nodes to associate.
When the Key Fob is in Scene Mode, pressing the control button, which will send the corresponding Scene id to the associated nodes.
